appDescription: An automatic corporate vehicle logbook that records each trip from the vehicle's gear and odometer for business tax records.

function.name: SET_TRIP_PURPOSE
function.description: Set the purpose of the trip being recorded now, or of the most recent trip, in the vehicle logbook.

purpose.description: Trip purpose category used for the business use ratio.

note.description: Short remark about the trip such as the visited client or task.

function.name: ADD_TRIP_EXPENSE
function.description: Attach a driving expense to the trip being recorded now, or to the most recent trip.

function.name: GET_DRIVING_LOG_SUMMARY
function.description: Report total distance, business distance, business use ratio, and trips without a purpose for a period.
